_comment: D-076 (E-256): the ONLY files under the v4 acceptance-grep roots allowed to name the retired providers or the retired test cloud. tests/suites/cli_test.sh (E-256 section) asserts the grep's hit set EQUALS this list, per-file line counts included. Kinds: removal (the D-074 registry and its consumers) | absence-test (tests of that removal or of absence). User-facing text can never be listed. A count change is an explicit edit here, in the diff.

entries.reason: Purges the retired providers' install-mirror trees from ~/.ai-os on upgrade (E-254/E-273).
_prune_legacy_workspaces names the v3 workspace dirs and shims it removes (E-254); the settings-allow cleanup names the retired CLI's Bash allow entries it drops.
The D-074 legacy-artefact registry (E-272): every entry names a path an earlier version left behind so ai clean / ai sync can find and remove it.
ai clean (E-272): comment naming the retired provider's home config dir as permanently not-ours, i.e. never removed.
ai init upgrade (E-270): rebinds a role bound to a retired provider back to the template default; the comment names that provider.
Fixtures the retired artefacts ai clean must list, move and restore, and asserts the retired provider's home dir is never touched.
Fixtures the v3 workspace dirs and shims and asserts ai sync prunes only what it generated (E-254; the sync_prune section, E-302).
This allowlist's own equality test (E-256 section, from legacy_mention — E-302): it carries the acceptance pattern and a planted-mention non-vacuity fixture.
E-255.9 (headless Tester section) asserts the retired test cloud is absent from registry.json, the MCP domains and a generated .mcp.json (written plainly per D-076, no split literal).
Builds a 3.0-shaped project bound to the retired providers and asserts ai init upgrades it off them.
Unit tests of the D-074 legacy registry's entries and classes (E-272).
Unit tests of the ai init upgrade's rebinding of roles and providers.json off the retired providers (E-270).
